content.user_title: Manage Agent Skills with the Skills CLI
content.value_statement: Finding and maintaining agent skills can be slow across tools and machines. This skill guides discovery, installation, updates, backups, and troubleshooting with the skills CLI.
actual_capabilities: Guides skill discovery through skills.sh and skills CLI search.
Explains install sources for GitHub, GitLab, git URLs, local packages, and specific skills.
Shows how to list, check, update, remove, initialize, restore, and sync installed skills.
Helps choose symlink or copy installation methods based on the environment.
Provides recommendation formats with install count, source reputation, and repository quality checks.
Routes portable backup and restore workflows to Skills Vault when a manifest is needed.
limitations: Does not verify live install counts unless the assistant checks current sources.
Does not replace security review for third-party skills before installation.
Depends on the installed skills CLI behavior and available package sources.
Does not author new skill content; it routes that work to a skill-authoring workflow.

use_cases.title: Find a Reliable Skill
use_cases.description: Compare marketplace options, check source quality, and recommend an installable skill for a specific task.

use_cases.title: Install Skills for an Agent
use_cases.description: Choose the right source, skill name, agent target, and scope for a Codex or Claude Code setup.

use_cases.title: Restore Team Skill Setups
use_cases.description: Use lock files or Skills Vault guidance to reproduce installed skills across machines.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a reliable skill for React performance work. Compare options and recommend one for Codex.

prompt_templates.title: Install One Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me install the best skill for changelog generation into Claude Code. Explain the source and scope first.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain Installed Skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Check how I should list, update, and remove installed skills for my Codex environment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Team Restore
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable workflow for backing up and restoring our team agent skills across new developer machines.

output_examples.input: Find a skill for end-to-end testing in Codex.
output_examples.output: A ranked recommendation with skill name, source, quality notes, install guidance, and a skills.sh reference.

output_examples.input: Install the screenshot skill for Claude Code.
output_examples.output: A confirmation-oriented install plan that explains the target agent, source, scope, and expected result.

output_examples.input: Move my installed skills to a new laptop.
output_examples.output: A backup and restore plan using Skills Vault or lock-file workflows, with warnings for source verification.

best_practices: Check source reputation, repository quality, and install count before recommending community skills.
Confirm target agent and install scope before adding flags that change where skills are installed.
Use Skills Vault when the user needs repeatable backup or team restore workflows.
anti_patterns: Recommending the first search result without checking source and quality.
Using older owner slash repo at skill syntax instead of current add syntax.
Adding confirmation-skip flags during personal installs without a clear user request.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps users discover, install, manage, back up, restore, and troubleshoot Agent Skills with the skills CLI.

faq.question: Does it install skills automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and commands that should be confirmed before changing an agent environment.

faq.question: Which agents are covered?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill installations.

faq.question: Can it find trustworthy skills?
faq.answer: It guides searches through skills.sh and CLI search, then checks install count, source reputation, and repository quality.

faq.question: Can it help with backups?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains lock-file restore paths and points portable manifest workflows to Skills Vault.

faq.question: Can it create a new skill?
faq.answer: It can explain initialization commands, but detailed skill authoring should use a dedicated authoring workflow.
